item.title: LG Manoj Sinha inaugurates redeveloped Amira Kadal pedestrian bridge in Srinagar
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 20: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha on Tuesday inaugurated the revamped Amira Kadal in Srinagar. The pedestrian bridge has been redeveloped under the Srinagar Smart City Project, officials said. An official said that the bridge, one of the oldest in Srinagar, has been transformed into a pedestrian bridge to enhance public movement and promote heritage aesthetics along the Jhelum riverfront. item.description: Srinagar,Jan 20: The Sub Divisional Magistrate Gulmarg on Tuesday issued a fresh weather advisory, warning of back-to-back western disturbances likely to affect Jammu and Kashmir, including Gulmarg and adjoining areas of Baramulla district, over the coming days. item.title: Farooq Abdullah rejects Mehbooba Mufti’s demand for new districts
item.description: Jammu ,Jan 20: National Conference president Farooq Abdullah on Tuesday asserted that Ladakh will sooner or later become a part of Jammu and Kashmir again, stating that people in the region are now repenting the decision taken in 2019. item.title: Tight Security deployed on NH-44, Kulgam ahead of Republic Day
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 21: Ahead of Republic Day celebrations, Kulgam Police have intensified security measures along the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway (NH-44) and across various parts of Kulgam district to thwart any attempts to disturb peace and public order. A senior official said that the heightened security drive is being carried out on the directions of SSP Kulgam, Shri Anayat Ali Choudhary (IPS). item.title: CM Omar to Chair Cabinet Meeting in Jammu Today
item.description: Jammu,Jan 22: The Jammu and Kashmir Cabinet, headed by Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, is scheduled to meet this morning at the Civil Secretariat, Jammu, with several key policy and administrative matters lined up for discussion. Highly placed sources said that the Cabinet is likely to clear the new Excise Policy for 2026–27, as the current policy ends on March 31, 2026. item.description: Jammu,Jan 22: A male employee of Jammu University was found hanging from a tree inside the university campus on Thursday morning, officials said, triggering shock among staff and students.
